builder_notes.pattern: export type { X } vs export { X } for TypeScript enums
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: TS1362: 'X' cannot be used as a value because it was exported using 'export type'. TypeScript enums compile to both a type AND a value.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Use export { EnumName } (not export type) for any enum used as a runtime value. Use export type only for pure interfaces and type aliases.
builder_notes.stack_example: packages/core/src/sorting.ts re-exports AttributeType; test uses AttributeType.String as runtime enum — requires export { AttributeType }.

builder_notes.pattern: prevWasQuote state not propagated to field-separator check in CSV parser
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: All fields of a quoted-CSV row merge into one string; parseCSVLine('"A","B"') returns ['A,B'] instead of ['A','B'].
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When tracking prevWasQuote for RFC-4180 escaped quotes, ensure field-separator branch also fires when prevWasQuote is true: (ch === ',' && (prevWasQuote || !insideQuotes)).
builder_notes.stack_example: modelResolver.ts:parseCSVLine — condition ch === ',' && !insideQuotes missed closing-quote-then-comma transition.

builder_notes.pattern: Test expected-value drift when implementation changes averaging denominator
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: toBeCloseTo(1.25) fails with 1.5; test comment says 'excluding unranked' but implementation includes unranked in totalItems used for average.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Derive expected values from the same formula the implementation uses, referencing fixture data explicitly. Update the test comment and expected value together when denominator changes.
builder_notes.stack_example: analytics.test.ts:66: averageItemsPerTier = totalItems (including unranked=6) / tierOrder.length (4) = 1.5; old comment said (2+2+1+0)/4 = 1.25.

builder_notes.pattern: Latent type bugs in selectors referencing nonexistent fields
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A selector returns undefined or null in production for a field that 'should' exist; TypeScript doesn't catch it if the type definition and runtime state diverge silently
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Write a single test for each selector that asserts a non-null/non-undefined value against a constructed state; compile error surfaces the field mismatch
builder_notes.stack_example: selectors.ts:103: state.theme.availableThemes — ThemeState only has selectedThemeId; TypeScript compiled silently because createSelector had implicit any typing

builder_notes.pattern: Cross-slice thunk integration tests
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A thunk dispatches to two or more slice reducers; test suite covers each slice independently but no test builds a real store and exercises the combined round-trip
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For each thunk spanning ≥2 slices, one configureStore-based test that dispatches the thunk and asserts getState() across both slices
builder_notes.stack_example: undoRedoThunks.test.ts: captureSnapshot + performUndo tested against a real store instance asserting both state.undoRedo.past and state.tier.tiers

builder_notes.pattern: Global dependency manipulation in tests (Object.defineProperty(global, 'localStorage'))
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Test beforeEach installs a global override; afterEach removes it; tests are order-sensitive if teardown fails
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Add an optional storage?: Storage parameter to the middleware/function under test with localStorage as default; tests pass an in-memory stub directly
builder_notes.stack_example: persistenceMiddleware.ts: adding storage param eliminates all Object.defineProperty in tests
